يخترطوا (form VIII)
# يَخْتَرِطُوا (yaḵtariṭū) /jax.ta.ri.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# يُخْتَرَطُوا (yuḵtaraṭū) /jux.ta.ra.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
